title: Positive edge count under a surviving step
statement: Let $s$ and $t$ be states of the contraction process, each a multigraph equipped with a distinguished cut. If $t$ arises from $s$ by a surviving step — that is, by contracting some edge of the multigraph of $s$ that does not cross the distinguished cut of $s$ — then the multigraph of $s$ has positive edge count.
hypotheses_covered: s and t are states (each a multigraph with a distinguished cut)
there is a surviving step from s to t (t is obtained by contracting some non-crossing edge of the multigraph of s)
replaced:
If some state $t$ is reachable from $s$ by a surviving step, then $s.G$ has positive edge
count.
